Hi Marta / AP team,

Hope you’re well — quick touch on invoice 2027-135 (attached). Our finance team is closing monthly remits next week and we wanted to confirm Astrolite’s preferred payment path for this one: ACH (SEPA) or international wire. If you can share the ETA (date) for payment it would help us plan the collection batch.

Two small asks that often block processing on our side:
- VAT/residency: can you confirm the billing entity and VAT ID you’re using for this invoice? If you’re remitting from a UK or EU entity, please reply with the VAT number so we can avoid withholding.
- Remittance reference: please include invoice number 2027-135 in the payment reference so we can auto-apply.

I’ve attached the invoice and our wire instructions in case AP wants to wire. If ACH/virtual card is preferred, tell us and we’ll send the payment link.

Thanks — can you please confirm by EOD Tuesday (July 13)? Small timing here will avoid a hold on your account.

Best,

Hi Jonas — thanks for the note.

We received the invoice and have two internal questions before we can schedule payment:
1) Which Redwood legal entity issued the invoice? Our AR team needs the exact entity name for cross-border VAT handling.
2) Do you confirm that the payable amount includes VAT or is the invoice net of VAT? Our platform will withhold if VAT is not provided.

We can do SEPA transfer (ACH equivalent) from our EU entity; wire is also possible but incurs extra fees on our side. If you can confirm the entity + VAT treatment I’ll route to payments and aim to schedule for July 20.

Best,
Marta Ruiz

Hi Marta — thanks for the quick reply, and great question.

Quick answers:
- Legal issuer: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) — we issued under Redwood Inference, Inc. if your ERP requires the full legal line, use: Redwood Inference, Inc., 220 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103, US.
- VAT: This invoice is net of VAT (no VAT charged). If Astrolite is an EU-registered VAT payer and can provide a valid EU VAT number for the billing entity, we’ll mark it as VAT-exempt on our side to avoid withholding. Otherwise, local withholding may apply.

If SEPA is easiest for you, the attached wire instructions include our EUR account. We can accept SEPA and will reconcile against invoice 2027-135 if you put the invoice number in the remittance field.

If it helps, we can offer a 14-day payment window extension for this invoice while you confirm VAT details (no fees). Let us know which route you prefer (SEPA / wire / virtual card) and whether you’ll provide the VAT number.

Thanks,
Jonas
